* **How many *minutes* are there in one full day?**
  **1,440 minutes** ($24 \text{ hours} \times 60 \text{ minutes}$).

* **How many *seconds* are there in one full day?**
  **86,400 seconds** ($24 \text{ hours} \times 60 \text{ minutes} \times 60 \text{ seconds}$).
